--- backend/ahuora-builder/src/geothermal_plant.py	
+++ backend/ahuora-builder/src/geothermal_plant.py	
@@ -1,209 +1,255 @@
 """Steady-state geothermal-heated n-butane power-loop flowsheet."""
 
 from __future__ import annotations
 
 import pyomo.environ as pyo
 from pyomo.network import Arc, SequentialDecomposition
 from pyomo.util.infeasible import log_infeasible_bounds, log_infeasible_constraints
 
 import idaes.logger as idaeslog
 from ahuora_builder.custom.custom_heat_exchanger import CustomHeatExchanger
 from ahuora_builder.custom.updated_pressure_changer import Pump, Turbine
 from ahuora_builder.replacement.specifications import SpecificationState
 from ahuora_property_packages.helmholtz.helmholtz_builder import build_helmholtz_package
 from idaes.core import FlowsheetBlock
 from idaes.core.solvers import get_solver
 from idaes.core.util.model_statistics import degrees_of_freedom
 from idaes.models.unit_models import Mixer, MomentumMixingType
 from idaes.core.util.model_diagnostics import DiagnosticsToolbox
 
 
 TIME = 0
 
 
 def build_geothermal_plant() -> pyo.ConcreteModel:
     """Build, connect, and specify the geothermal power-loop model."""
     model = pyo.ConcreteModel()
     model.fs = FlowsheetBlock(dynamic=False)
     setup_model(model)
     specify_model(model)
     return model
 
 
 def setup_model(model: pyo.ConcreteModel) -> None:
     """Create property packages, unit operations, and process arcs."""
     fs = model.fs
     fs.butane = build_helmholtz_package(["n-butane"])
     fs.water = build_helmholtz_package(["water"])
     fs.pump = Pump(property_package=fs.butane)
     fs.turbine = Turbine(property_package=fs.butane)
     fs.recuperator = CustomHeatExchanger(
         hot_side_name="shell",
         cold_side_name="tube",
         shell={"property_package": fs.butane, "has_pressure_change": True},
         tube={"property_package": fs.butane, "has_pressure_change": True},
     )
     fs.preheater = CustomHeatExchanger(
         hot_side_name="shell",
         cold_side_name="tube",
         shell={"property_package": fs.water, "has_pressure_change": True},
         tube={"property_package": fs.butane, "has_pressure_change": True},
     )
     fs.vaporiser = CustomHeatExchanger(
         hot_side_name="shell",
         cold_side_name="tube",
         shell={"property_package": fs.water, "has_pressure_change": True},
         tube={"property_package": fs.butane, "has_pressure_change": True},
     )
     fs.condenser = CustomHeatExchanger(
         hot_side_name="shell",
         cold_side_name="tube",
         shell={"property_package": fs.butane, "has_pressure_change": True},
         tube={"property_package": fs.water, "has_pressure_change": True},
     )
     fs.water_mixer = Mixer(
         property_package=fs.water,
         inlet_list=["geothermal", "auxiliary"],
         momentum_mixing_type=MomentumMixingType.minimize,
     )
     fs.condenser_to_pump = Arc(source=fs.condenser.shell_outlet, destination=fs.pump.inlet)
     fs.pump_to_recuperator = Arc(source=fs.pump.outlet, destination=fs.recuperator.tube_inlet)
     fs.recuperator_to_preheater = Arc(source=fs.recuperator.tube_outlet, destination=fs.preheater.tube_inlet)
     fs.preheater_to_vaporiser = Arc(source=fs.preheater.tube_outlet, destination=fs.vaporiser.tube_inlet)
     fs.vaporiser_to_turbine = Arc(source=fs.vaporiser.tube_outlet, destination=fs.turbine.inlet)
     fs.turbine_to_recuperator = Arc(source=fs.turbine.outlet, destination=fs.recuperator.shell_inlet)
     fs.recuperator_to_condenser = Arc(source=fs.recuperator.shell_outlet, destination=fs.condenser.shell_inlet)
     fs.vaporiser_to_mixer = Arc(source=fs.vaporiser.shell_outlet, destination=fs.water_mixer.geothermal)
     fs.mixer_to_preheater = Arc(source=fs.water_mixer.outlet, destination=fs.preheater.shell_inlet)
     pyo.TransformationFactory("network.expand_arcs").apply_to(model)
     specs = SpecificationState.for_flowsheet(fs)
     specs.declare_inlet_port(fs.water_mixer.auxiliary)
     specs.register_unconnected_inlets()
 
 
 def specify_model(model: pyo.ConcreteModel) -> None:
     """Set specifications and guesses, then activate all replacement targets."""
     fs = model.fs
     specs = SpecificationState.for_flowsheet(fs)
     butane = fs.butane
     water = fs.water
 
     # The circulation rate is the sole recycle specification without a unit owner.
     # This is the only variable that needs to be fixed like this.
     fs.pump.inlet.pressure[TIME].set_value(100.0e5)
     specs.anchor_loop_variable(fs.pump.inlet.flow_mol)
     specs.fix(fs.pump.inlet.flow_mol, 1.0)
 
     # This provides an example of fixing an inlet port conditions.
     # These variables can be fixed using specs.fix() as they are canonical variables.
     # The list of canonical variables is shown in debug_model() output.
     specs.fix(fs.vaporiser.shell_inlet.flow_mol, 770.9510005)
     specs.fix(fs.vaporiser.shell_inlet.pressure, 23.0e5)
     specs.fix(
         fs.vaporiser.shell_inlet.enth_mol,
         pyo.value(water.htpx(T=473.15 * pyo.units.K, p=23.0e5 * pyo.units.Pa)),
     )
     # This provides an example of replacing a canonical variable with a non-canonical variable,
     # specifying the condenser outlet temperature instead of the overall heat transfer coefficient.
     condenser_outlet_temperature = fs.condenser.shell.properties_out[TIME].get_as_var(
         fs.condenser.shell.properties_out[TIME].temperature
     )
     specs.replace(fs.condenser.overall_heat_transfer_coefficient, condenser_outlet_temperature)
     specs.fix(condenser_outlet_temperature, 274.970330261)
     print("Initial Specification State:")
     specs.report(fs)
 
     # CONTINUE IMPLEMENTING HERE.
+    specs.replace(fs.pump.work_mechanical, fs.pump.outlet.pressure)
+    specs.fix(fs.pump.outlet.pressure, 23.0e5)
+    specs.fix(fs.pump.efficiency_pump, 0.7)
 
+    specs.replace(fs.turbine.work_mechanical, fs.turbine.outlet.pressure)
+    specs.fix(fs.turbine.outlet.pressure, 100.0e5)
+    specs.fix(fs.turbine.efficiency_isentropic, 0.5)
 
+    recuperator_cold_outlet_temperature = fs.recuperator.tube.properties_out[TIME].get_as_var(
+        fs.recuperator.tube.properties_out[TIME].temperature
+    )
+    specs.replace(fs.recuperator.overall_heat_transfer_coefficient, recuperator_cold_outlet_temperature)
+    specs.fix(recuperator_cold_outlet_temperature, 333.15)
+    specs.fix(fs.recuperator.area, 1.0)
+    specs.fix(fs.recuperator.hot_side.deltaP, 0.0)
+    specs.fix(fs.recuperator.cold_side.deltaP, 0.0)
 
+    preheater_cold_outlet_temperature = fs.preheater.tube.properties_out[TIME].get_as_var(
+        fs.preheater.tube.properties_out[TIME].temperature
+    )
+    specs.replace(fs.preheater.overall_heat_transfer_coefficient, preheater_cold_outlet_temperature)
+    specs.fix(preheater_cold_outlet_temperature, 353.15)
+    specs.fix(fs.preheater.area, 5.0)
+    specs.fix(fs.preheater.hot_side.deltaP, 0.0)
+    specs.fix(fs.preheater.cold_side.deltaP, 0.0)
 
+    vaporiser_cold_outlet_temperature = fs.vaporiser.tube.properties_out[TIME].get_as_var(
+        fs.vaporiser.tube.properties_out[TIME].temperature
+    )
+    specs.replace(fs.vaporiser.overall_heat_transfer_coefficient, vaporiser_cold_outlet_temperature)
+    specs.fix(vaporiser_cold_outlet_temperature, 423.15)
+    specs.fix(fs.vaporiser.area, 5.0)
+    specs.fix(fs.vaporiser.hot_side.deltaP, 0.0)
+    specs.fix(fs.vaporiser.cold_side.deltaP, 0.0)
 
+    specs.fix(fs.condenser.area, 5.0)
+    specs.fix(fs.condenser.hot_side.deltaP, 0.0)
+    specs.fix(fs.condenser.cold_side.deltaP, 0.0)
+    specs.fix(fs.condenser.tube_inlet.flow_mol, 800.0)
+    specs.fix(fs.condenser.tube_inlet.pressure, 100.0e3)
+    specs.fix(
+        fs.condenser.tube_inlet.enth_mol,
+        pyo.value(water.htpx(T=274.15 * pyo.units.K, p=100.0e3 * pyo.units.Pa)),
+    )
 
+    specs.replace(fs.water_mixer.auxiliary.flow_mol, fs.preheater.shell_outlet.flow_mol)
+    specs.fix(fs.preheater.shell_outlet.flow_mol, 925.1412006)
+    specs.fix(fs.water_mixer.auxiliary.pressure, 150.0e3)
+    specs.fix(
+        fs.water_mixer.auxiliary.enth_mol,
+        pyo.value(water.htpx(T=368.15 * pyo.units.K, p=150.0e3 * pyo.units.Pa)),
+    )
     debug_model(model)
     if degrees_of_freedom(model) != 0:
         raise RuntimeError("The fully specified model must have zero degrees of freedom.")
 
 
 def debug_model(model: pyo.ConcreteModel) -> None:
     """Print the model's specification state and structural degree-of-freedom status."""
     fs = model.fs
     specs = fs.specifications
     print(f"Degrees of freedom: {degrees_of_freedom(model)}")
     dt = DiagnosticsToolbox(model)
     dt.display_overconstrained_set()
     dt.display_underconstrained_set()
     fs.pump.report()
     fs.turbine.report()
     fs.recuperator.report()
     fs.preheater.report()
     fs.vaporiser.report()
     fs.condenser.report()
     # This prints the canonical variables, and if they are replaced, the replacement variable.
     # The replacement system is used to maintain zero degrees of freedom; if you want to fix
     # a different variable, you have to replace a canonical variable with it (to maintain zero degrees of freedom).
     specs.report(fs)
 
 
 def initialise_model(model: pyo.ConcreteModel) -> None:
     """Initialize in sequential order while replacements are temporarily reverted."""
     fs = model.fs
     specifications = fs.specifications
     sequence = SequentialDecomposition(run_first_pass=True)
     sequence.options.tear_method = "Wegstein"
     sequence.options.iterLim = 5
     sequence.options.tol = 1e-6
     sequence.options.solve_tears = False
     graph = sequence.create_graph(model)
     tears = sequence.tear_set_arcs(graph, method="heuristic")
     sequence.set_tear_set(tears)
     for tear in tears:
         sequence.set_guesses_for(
             tear.destination,
             {
                 name: {TIME: pyo.value(variable[TIME])}
                 for name, variable in tear.destination.vars.items()
                 if TIME in variable
             },
         )
     print("Initialising model with sequential decomposition...")
     with specifications.replacements_suspended_in(fs):
         sequence.run(model, lambda unit: unit.initialize(outlvl=idaeslog.INFO))
         initial_results = get_solver().solve(model, tee=True, load_solutions=False)
         if initial_results.solver.termination_condition != pyo.TerminationCondition.optimal:
             diagnose_failed_solve(model)
             raise RuntimeError(f"Initial solve failed: {initial_results.solver.termination_condition}")
         model.solutions.load_from(initial_results)
 
 
 def diagnose_failed_solve(model: pyo.ConcreteModel) -> None:
     """Print infeasibilities and custom unit diagnostics after a failed solve."""
     logger = idaeslog.getLogger(__name__)
     log_infeasible_constraints(model, tol=1e-6, logger=logger)
     log_infeasible_bounds(model, tol=1e-6, logger=logger)
     print("Diagnosing failed solve...")
     for unit in model.fs.component_data_objects(pyo.Block, descend_into=False, active=True):
         if not hasattr(unit, "diagnose"):
             continue
         try:
             for component, message in unit.diagnose():
                 print(f"Unit diagnostic [{component.name}]: {message}")
         except Exception as error:
             print(f"Unit diagnostic [{unit.name}]: {type(error).__name__}: {error}")
 
 
 def solve(model: pyo.ConcreteModel | None = None):
     """Initialize a model, restore replacements, and solve its final specification state."""
     model = build_geothermal_plant() if model is None else model
     initialise_model(model)
     print("Performing final solve...")
     results = get_solver().solve(model, tee=True, load_solutions=False)
     if results.solver.termination_condition != pyo.TerminationCondition.optimal:
         diagnose_failed_solve(model)
         raise RuntimeError(f"Final solve failed: {results.solver.termination_condition}")
     model.solutions.load_from(results)
     return model, results
 
 
 if __name__ == "__main__":
     solved_model, _results = solve()

"""Steady-state geothermal-heated n-butane power-loop flowsheet."""

from __future__ import annotations

import pyomo.environ as pyo
from pyomo.network import Arc, SequentialDecomposition
from pyomo.util.infeasible import log_infeasible_bounds, log_infeasible_constraints

import idaes.logger as idaeslog
from ahuora_builder.custom.custom_heat_exchanger import CustomHeatExchanger
from ahuora_builder.custom.updated_pressure_changer import Pump, Turbine
from ahuora_builder.replacement.specifications import SpecificationState
from ahuora_property_packages.helmholtz.helmholtz_builder import build_helmholtz_package
from idaes.core import FlowsheetBlock
from idaes.core.solvers import get_solver
from idaes.core.util.model_statistics import degrees_of_freedom
from idaes.models.unit_models import Mixer, MomentumMixingType
from idaes.core.util.model_diagnostics import DiagnosticsToolbox


TIME = 0


def build_geothermal_plant() -> pyo.ConcreteModel:
    """Build, connect, and specify the geothermal power-loop model."""
    model = pyo.ConcreteModel()
    model.fs = FlowsheetBlock(dynamic=False)
    setup_model(model)
    specify_model(model)
    return model


def setup_model(model: pyo.ConcreteModel) -> None:
    """Create property packages, unit operations, and process arcs."""
    fs = model.fs
    fs.butane = build_helmholtz_package(["n-butane"])
    fs.water = build_helmholtz_package(["water"])
    fs.pump = Pump(property_package=fs.butane)
    fs.turbine = Turbine(property_package=fs.butane)
    fs.recuperator = CustomHeatExchanger(
        hot_side_name="shell",
        cold_side_name="tube",
        shell={"property_package": fs.butane, "has_pressure_change": True},
        tube={"property_package": fs.butane, "has_pressure_change": True},
    )
    fs.preheater = CustomHeatExchanger(
        hot_side_name="shell",
        cold_side_name="tube",
        shell={"property_package": fs.water, "has_pressure_change": True},
        tube={"property_package": fs.butane, "has_pressure_change": True},
    )
    fs.vaporiser = CustomHeatExchanger(
        hot_side_name="shell",
        cold_side_name="tube",
        shell={"property_package": fs.water, "has_pressure_change": True},
        tube={"property_package": fs.butane, "has_pressure_change": True},
    )
    fs.condenser = CustomHeatExchanger(
        hot_side_name="shell",
        cold_side_name="tube",
        shell={"property_package": fs.butane, "has_pressure_change": True},
        tube={"property_package": fs.water, "has_pressure_change": True},
    )
    fs.water_mixer = Mixer(
        property_package=fs.water,
        inlet_list=["geothermal", "auxiliary"],
        momentum_mixing_type=MomentumMixingType.minimize,
    )
    fs.condenser_to_pump = Arc(source=fs.condenser.shell_outlet, destination=fs.pump.inlet)
    fs.pump_to_recuperator = Arc(source=fs.pump.outlet, destination=fs.recuperator.tube_inlet)
    fs.recuperator_to_preheater = Arc(source=fs.recuperator.tube_outlet, destination=fs.preheater.tube_inlet)
    fs.preheater_to_vaporiser = Arc(source=fs.preheater.tube_outlet, destination=fs.vaporiser.tube_inlet)
    fs.vaporiser_to_turbine = Arc(source=fs.vaporiser.tube_outlet, destination=fs.turbine.inlet)
    fs.turbine_to_recuperator = Arc(source=fs.turbine.outlet, destination=fs.recuperator.shell_inlet)
    fs.recuperator_to_condenser = Arc(source=fs.recuperator.shell_outlet, destination=fs.condenser.shell_inlet)
    fs.vaporiser_to_mixer = Arc(source=fs.vaporiser.shell_outlet, destination=fs.water_mixer.geothermal)
    fs.mixer_to_preheater = Arc(source=fs.water_mixer.outlet, destination=fs.preheater.shell_inlet)
    pyo.TransformationFactory("network.expand_arcs").apply_to(model)
    specs = SpecificationState.for_flowsheet(fs)
    specs.declare_inlet_port(fs.water_mixer.auxiliary)
    specs.register_unconnected_inlets()


def specify_model(model: pyo.ConcreteModel) -> None:
    """Set specifications and guesses, then activate all replacement targets."""
    fs = model.fs
    specs = SpecificationState.for_flowsheet(fs)
    butane = fs.butane
    water = fs.water

    # The circulation rate is the sole recycle specification without a unit owner.
    # This is the only variable that needs to be fixed like this.
    fs.pump.inlet.pressure[TIME].set_value(100.0e5)
    specs.anchor_loop_variable(fs.pump.inlet.flow_mol)
    specs.fix(fs.pump.inlet.flow_mol, 1.0)

    # This provides an example of fixing an inlet port conditions.
    # These variables can be fixed using specs.fix() as they are canonical variables.
    # The list of canonical variables is shown in debug_model() output.
    specs.fix(fs.vaporiser.shell_inlet.flow_mol, 770.9510005)
    specs.fix(fs.vaporiser.shell_inlet.pressure, 23.0e5)
    specs.fix(
        fs.vaporiser.shell_inlet.enth_mol,
        pyo.value(water.htpx(T=473.15 * pyo.units.K, p=23.0e5 * pyo.units.Pa)),
    )
    # This provides an example of replacing a canonical variable with a non-canonical variable,
    # specifying the condenser outlet temperature instead of the overall heat transfer coefficient.
    condenser_outlet_temperature = fs.condenser.shell.properties_out[TIME].get_as_var(
        fs.condenser.shell.properties_out[TIME].temperature
    )
    specs.replace(fs.condenser.overall_heat_transfer_coefficient, condenser_outlet_temperature)
    specs.fix(condenser_outlet_temperature, 274.970330261)
    print("Initial Specification State:")
    specs.report(fs)

    # CONTINUE IMPLEMENTING HERE.






    debug_model(model)
    if degrees_of_freedom(model) != 0:
        raise RuntimeError("The fully specified model must have zero degrees of freedom.")


def debug_model(model: pyo.ConcreteModel) -> None:
    """Print the model's specification state and structural degree-of-freedom status."""
    fs = model.fs
    specs = fs.specifications
    print(f"Degrees of freedom: {degrees_of_freedom(model)}")
    dt = DiagnosticsToolbox(model)
    dt.display_overconstrained_set()
    dt.display_underconstrained_set()
    fs.pump.report()
    fs.turbine.report()
    fs.recuperator.report()
    fs.preheater.report()
    fs.vaporiser.report()
    fs.condenser.report()
    # This prints the canonical variables, and if they are replaced, the replacement variable.
    # The replacement system is used to maintain zero degrees of freedom; if you want to fix
    # a different variable, you have to replace a canonical variable with it (to maintain zero degrees of freedom).
    specs.report(fs)


def initialise_model(model: pyo.ConcreteModel) -> None:
    """Initialize in sequential order while replacements are temporarily reverted."""
    fs = model.fs
    specifications = fs.specifications
    sequence = SequentialDecomposition(run_first_pass=True)
    sequence.options.tear_method = "Wegstein"
    sequence.options.iterLim = 5
    sequence.options.tol = 1e-6
    sequence.options.solve_tears = False
    graph = sequence.create_graph(model)
    tears = sequence.tear_set_arcs(graph, method="heuristic")
    sequence.set_tear_set(tears)
    for tear in tears:
        sequence.set_guesses_for(
            tear.destination,
            {
                name: {TIME: pyo.value(variable[TIME])}
                for name, variable in tear.destination.vars.items()
                if TIME in variable
            },
        )
    print("Initialising model with sequential decomposition...")
    with specifications.replacements_suspended_in(fs):
        sequence.run(model, lambda unit: unit.initialize(outlvl=idaeslog.INFO))
        initial_results = get_solver().solve(model, tee=True, load_solutions=False)
        if initial_results.solver.termination_condition != pyo.TerminationCondition.optimal:
            diagnose_failed_solve(model)
            raise RuntimeError(f"Initial solve failed: {initial_results.solver.termination_condition}")
        model.solutions.load_from(initial_results)


def diagnose_failed_solve(model: pyo.ConcreteModel) -> None:
    """Print infeasibilities and custom unit diagnostics after a failed solve."""
    logger = idaeslog.getLogger(__name__)
    log_infeasible_constraints(model, tol=1e-6, logger=logger)
    log_infeasible_bounds(model, tol=1e-6, logger=logger)
    print("Diagnosing failed solve...")
    for unit in model.fs.component_data_objects(pyo.Block, descend_into=False, active=True):
        if not hasattr(unit, "diagnose"):
            continue
        try:
            for component, message in unit.diagnose():
                print(f"Unit diagnostic [{component.name}]: {message}")
        except Exception as error:
            print(f"Unit diagnostic [{unit.name}]: {type(error).__name__}: {error}")


def solve(model: pyo.ConcreteModel | None = None):
    """Initialize a model, restore replacements, and solve its final specification state."""
    model = build_geothermal_plant() if model is None else model
    initialise_model(model)
    print("Performing final solve...")
    results = get_solver().solve(model, tee=True, load_solutions=False)
    if results.solver.termination_condition != pyo.TerminationCondition.optimal:
        diagnose_failed_solve(model)
        raise RuntimeError(f"Final solve failed: {results.solver.termination_condition}")
    model.solutions.load_from(results)
    return model, results


if __name__ == "__main__":
    solved_model, _results = solve()

4: 
5: This steady-state process model represents a closed, pure n-butane power loop
6: heated by a once-through geothermal-water surrogate and cooled by a separate
7: water utility. Heat is supplied in a preheater and vaporiser; heat from the
8: post-turbine organic stream is recovered in a recuperator. No chemical reaction,
9: mass transfer between process sides, or mixing of n-butane with water is
10: modelled.
11: 
12: The geothermal stream is **pure water**, not brine: salts, non-condensable
13: gases, scaling, and brine-property effects are absent. Both fluids use a
14: Helmholtz-equation-of-state property package with liquid and vapour phases:
15: 
16: | Fluid circuit | Component definition | Phases represented |
17: |---|---|---|
18: | Organic working fluid | 100 mol% n-butane | liquid, vapour |
19: | Geothermal and cooling-water streams | 100 mol% water | liquid, vapour |
20: 
21: All equipment is represented at steady state. The heat exchangers use specified
22: area and an overall heat-transfer relationship; exchanger pressure drops are
23: specified as zero. No exchanger geometry beyond area, heat-loss model, piping
24: drop, pump curve, turbine map, mechanical design, or control system is supplied.
25: 
26: ## Process configuration
27: 
28: ### Organic working-fluid circuit
29: 
30: The 1 mol/s n-butane circuit follows this physical sequence:
31: 
32: `condenser -> Pump1 -> recuperator cold side -> preheater cold side -> vaporiser cold side -> Turbine1 -> recuperator hot side -> condenser`
33: 
34: The condenser produces liquid n-butane, the pump changes its pressure, the
35: recuperator and geothermal exchangers heat it, and the vaporiser outlet is sent
36: to the turbine. The turbine discharge gives up heat to the pressurised liquid or
37: subcooled/partly heated side of the recuperator before returning to the
38: condenser.
39: 
40: The specified pressure directions must be retained exactly when recreating this
41: case, even though they are opposite to conventional pump and turbine service:
42: 
43: | Organic section | Inlet pressure | Outlet pressure | Pressure change |
44: |---|---:|---:|---:|
45: | Pump1 | 100 bar | 23 bar | -77 bar (-7.70 MPa) |
46: | Vaporiser, cold side | 23 bar | 23 bar | 0 kPa |
47: | Turbine1 | 23 bar | 100 bar | +77 bar (+7.70 MPa) |
48: | Recuperator, hot side | 100 bar | 100 bar | 0 kPa |
49: | Condenser, hot side | 100 bar | 100 bar | 0 kPa |
50: 
51: Thus, the saved solution is not a physically conventional pressure-raising pump
52: followed by an expanding turbine. It is a mathematical process configuration
53: with a pressure-reducing unit named Pump1 and a pressure-increasing unit named
54: Turbine1.
55: 
56: ### Geothermal-water circuit
57: 
58: Pure water at 50 t/h, 200 degC, and 23 bar enters the hot side of the vaporiser.
59: It transfers heat to n-butane, then combines with a second pure-water stream at
60: 95 degC and 150 kPa. The combined water passes through the hot side of the
61: preheater and leaves the process.
62: 
63: The second water stream is determined by the total preheater hot-side outlet
64: flow specification of 60 t/h. Consequently, with the 50 t/h geothermal feed,
65: the solved auxiliary-water rate is 154.1902001 mol/s, approximately 10 t/h.
66: The modelled mixer outlet and the preheater hot side are at 150 kPa. This
67: implicitly reduces the 23-bar vaporiser effluent to the lower mixing pressure;
68: no valve or other pressure-letdown equipment is represented.
69: 
70: ### Cooling-water circuit
71: 
72: Separate pure cooling water enters the condenser cold side at 800 mol/s, 1.0000
73: degC, and 100 kPa. It absorbs the condenser duty and exits as a utility return.
74: There is no specified temperature, pressure, or flow adjustment at the return;
75: the condenser cold-side pressure drop is zero.
76: 
77: ## Boundary Conditions and Design Specifications
78: 
79: ### Independently specified feeds and product condition
80: 
81: | Location | Fluid | Specified condition |
82: |---|---|---|
83: | Pump1 inlet / condenser organic outlet | n-butane | 1.0000 mol/s, 100 mol% n-butane, 1.820330261 degC, 100.0000000 bar, vapour fraction = 0 |
84: | Vaporiser hot-side inlet | water | 50.0000 t/h, 100 mol% water, 200.0000000 degC, 23.0000000 bar |
85: | Auxiliary mixer inlet | water | 100 mol% water, 95.0000000 degC, 150.0000 kPa; flow is set by the 60 t/h combined-water condition |
86: | Preheater hot-side outlet | water | 60.0000 t/h total water flow |
87: | Condenser cold-side inlet | water | 800.0000 mol/s, 100 mol% water, 1.000000000 degC, 100.0000 kPa |
88: | Condenser hot-side outlet | n-butane | vapour fraction = 0 |
89: 
90: ### Unit-operation specifications
91: 
92: | Unit operation | Process-side service | Fixed specifications |
93: |---|---|---|
94: | Pump1 | n-butane | Isentropic pump efficiency = 0.7000; outlet pressure = 23.0000000 bar |
95: | Vaporiser | Water hot side; n-butane cold side | Area = 5.0000 m2; n-butane outlet temperature = 150.0000000 degC; water-side and n-butane-side pressure drops = 0 kPa |
96: | Preheater | Water hot side; n-butane cold side | Area = 5.0000 m2; n-butane outlet temperature = 80.0000000 degC; pressure drops = 0 kPa on both sides |
97: | Recuperator | n-butane hot and cold sides | Area = 1.0000 m2; n-butane cold-side outlet temperature = 60.0000000 degC; pressure drops = 0 kPa on both sides |
98: | Condenser | n-butane hot side; water cold side | Area = 5.0000 m2; n-butane hot-side outlet vapour fraction = 0; pressure drops = 0 kPa on both sides |
99: | Turbine1 | n-butane | Isentropic calculation; isentropic efficiency = 0.5000; motor efficiency = 1.0000; outlet pressure = 100.0000000 bar |
100: | Mixer | water | Two inlets, no heat or shaft work specified; combined outlet flow is governed by the 60 t/h downstream specification |
101: 
102: The saved overall heat-transfer coefficients are 61.11845911 W/(m2.K) for the
103: vaporiser, 15.60345335 W/(m2.K) for the preheater, 53.09910952 W/(m2.K) for the
104: recuperator, and 161.3163204 W/(m2.K) for the condenser. They are saved
105: initialization/solved values rather than independent design inputs; the outlet
106: targets above are paired with the exchanger heat-transfer equations.
107: 
108: ## Process Equations and Closure
109: 
110: For each exchanger, the energy balance is
111: 
112: \[
113: Q_{\mathrm{cold}} = -Q_{\mathrm{hot}}
114: \]
115: 
116: and the heat-transfer relation is represented by
117: 
118: \[
119: Q = U A \Delta T_{\mathrm{lm}}, \qquad
120: \Delta T_{\mathrm{lm}} =
121: \frac{\Delta T_1-\Delta T_2}{\ln(\Delta T_1/\Delta T_2)}.
122: \]
123: 
124: Each exchanger additionally conserves component flow on each side and uses the
125: specified zero pressure drop. The water mixer obeys total mass and enthalpy
126: balances,
127: 
128: \[
129: \dot m_{out}=\dot m_1+\dot m_2, \qquad
130: \dot m_{out}h_{out}=\dot m_1h_1+\dot m_2h_2,
131: \]
132: 
133: with its outlet at the lower inlet pressure in the saved solution (150 kPa).
134: 
135: The pump and turbine use material and energy balances, their specified pressure
136: changes, and the stated efficiencies. The isentropic turbine relationship may
137: be expressed as
138: 
139: \[
140: \eta_{is}=\frac{h_{in}-h_{out}}{h_{in}-h_{out,s}},
141: \]
142: 
143: using the model's sign and pressure conventions. The saved pressure rise across
144: the unit called Turbine1 makes the resulting enthalpy and work directions
145: unconventional; the equation should therefore be implemented according to the
146: chosen simulator's turbine convention and checked against the results below.
147: 
148: In process terms, the case is closed by the n-butane circulation rate and
149: condenser liquid condition, the two organic pressure levels, three organic
150: heater outlet-temperature targets, the condenser vapour-fraction target, the
151: three external water-feed conditions, and the 60 t/h mixed-water flow. Heat
152: duties, the auxiliary-water rate, exchanger coefficients, unprescribed outlet
153: states, and shaft powers are calculated. No optimization, rating calculation,
154: or dynamic accumulation is included.
155: 
156: ## Saved Results and Reproduction Checks
157: 
158: The following values are saved solved/initialization results. They are useful
159: for reproducing this exact case, but values identified above as calculated are
160: not additional design specifications.
161: 
162: ### Heat duties and temperature approaches
163: 
164: Positive duty denotes heat received by the cold side.
165: 
166: | Exchanger | Heat duty to cold side (kW) | Temperature difference at one end (degC) | Temperature difference at other end (degC) |
167: |---|---:|---:|---:|
168: | Vaporiser | 24.39085075 | 50.00000000 | 119.6088786 |
169: | Preheater | 3.163201216 | 31.36334627 | 51.36334285 |
170: | Recuperator | 8.982202672 | 158.7379939 | 180.0268024 |
171: | Condenser | 28.13397564 | 175.4808630 | 0.8203302612 |
172:

176: 
177: ### Organic-stream checks
178: 
179: Enthalpies below are the saved property-package values in J/mol; their zero is
180: the property package reference state.
181: 
182: | Organic location | Flow (mol/s) | Pressure (bar) | Temperature if specified (degC) | Enthalpy (J/mol) |
183: |---|---:|---:|---:|---:|
184: | Condenser outlet / Pump1 inlet | 1.0000 | 100 | 1.820330261 | -24341.82120 |
185: | Pump1 outlet / recuperator cold inlet | 1.0000 | 23 | not specified | -25396.44445 |
186: | Recuperator cold outlet / preheater inlet | 1.0000 | 23 | 60.00000000 | -16414.24178 |
187: | Preheater cold outlet / vaporiser inlet | 1.0000 | 23 | 80.00000000 | -13251.04057 |
188: | Vaporiser cold outlet / Turbine1 inlet | 1.0000 | 23 | 150.0000000 | 11139.81018 |
189: | Turbine1 outlet / recuperator hot inlet | 1.0000 | 100 | not specified | 12774.35711 |
190: | Recuperator hot outlet / condenser inlet | 1.0000 | 100 | not specified | 3792.154442 |
191: 
192: The saved Pump1 mechanical work is -1.054623259 kW and the saved Turbine1
193: mechanical and electrical work is +1.634546934 kW. Their algebraic sum is
194: **+0.579923675 kW**. These are reported with the model's work signs, not
195: relabelled as conventional power consumption or generation.
196:

198: 
199: | Water location | Flow (mol/s) | Pressure | Temperature if specified (degC) | Enthalpy (J/mol) |
200: |---|---:|---:|---:|---:|
201: | Vaporiser water inlet | 770.9510005 | 23 bar | 200.0000000 | 15358.06828 |
202: | Vaporiser water outlet / first mixer inlet | 770.9510005 | 23 bar | 199.6088786 | 15326.43092 |
203: | Auxiliary mixer inlet | 154.1902001 | 150 kPa | 95.00000000 | 7172.033816 |
204: | Mixer outlet / preheater water inlet | 925.1412006 | 150 kPa | not specified | 13967.36474 |
205: | Preheater water outlet | 925.1412006 | 150 kPa | not specified | 13963.94558 |
206: | Condenser cooling-water inlet | 800.0000000 | 100 kPa | 1.000000000 | 77.05317402 |
207: | Condenser cooling-water outlet | 800.0000000 | 100 kPa | not specified | 112.2206436 |

209: ## Limits of Interpretation
210: 
211: The model encodes pure-water heat-source and utility streams, so it cannot
212: predict brine salinity effects, flashing caused by dissolved solids, corrosion,

`condenser -> Pump1 -> recuperator cold side -> preheater cold side -> vaporiser cold side -> Turbine1 -> recuperator hot side -> condenser`

The condenser produces liquid n-butane, the pump changes its pressure, the
recuperator and geothermal exchangers heat it, and the vaporiser outlet is sent
to the turbine. The turbine discharge gives up heat to the pressurised liquid or
subcooled/partly heated side of the recuperator before returning to the
condenser.

The specified pressure directions must be retained exactly when recreating this
case, even though they are opposite to conventional pump and turbine service:

| Organic section | Inlet pressure | Outlet pressure | Pressure change |
|---|---:|---:|---:|
| Pump1 | 100 bar | 23 bar | -77 bar (-7.70 MPa) |
| Vaporiser, cold side | 23 bar | 23 bar | 0 kPa |
| Turbine1 | 23 bar | 100 bar | +77 bar (+7.70 MPa) |
| Recuperator, hot side | 100 bar | 100 bar | 0 kPa |
| Condenser, hot side | 100 bar | 100 bar | 0 kPa |

Thus, the saved solution is not a physically conventional pressure-raising pump
followed by an expanding turbine. It is a mathematical process configuration
with a pressure-reducing unit named Pump1 and a pressure-increasing unit named
Turbine1.

### Geothermal-water circuit

Pure water at 50 t/h, 200 degC, and 23 bar enters the hot side of the vaporiser.
It transfers heat to n-butane, then combines with a second pure-water stream at
95 degC and 150 kPa. The combined water passes through the hot side of the
preheater and leaves the process.

The second water stream is determined by the total preheater hot-side outlet
flow specification of 60 t/h. Consequently, with the 50 t/h geothermal feed,
the solved auxiliary-water rate is 154.1902001 mol/s, approximately 10 t/h.
The modelled mixer outlet and the preheater hot side are at 150 kPa. This
implicitly reduces the 23-bar vaporiser effluent to the lower mixing pressure;
no valve or other pressure-letdown equipment is represented.

### Cooling-water circuit

Separate pure cooling water enters the condenser cold side at 800 mol/s, 1.0000
degC, and 100 kPa. It absorbs the condenser duty and exits as a utility return.
There is no specified temperature, pressure, or flow adjustment at the return;
the condenser cold-side pressure drop is zero.

## Boundary Conditions and Design Specifications

### Independently specified feeds and product condition

| Location | Fluid | Specified condition |
|---|---|---|
| Pump1 inlet / condenser organic outlet | n-butane | 1.0000 mol/s, 100 mol% n-butane, 1.820330261 degC, 100.0000000 bar, vapour fraction = 0 |
| Vaporiser hot-side inlet | water | 50.0000 t/h, 100 mol% water, 200.0000000 degC, 23.0000000 bar |
| Auxiliary mixer inlet | water | 100 mol% water, 95.0000000 degC, 150.0000 kPa; flow is set by the 60 t/h combined-water condition |
| Preheater hot-side outlet | water | 60.0000 t/h total water flow |
| Condenser cold-side inlet | water | 800.0000 mol/s, 100 mol% water, 1.000000000 degC, 100.0000 kPa |
| Condenser hot-side outlet | n-butane | vapour fraction = 0 |

### Unit-operation specifications

| Unit operation | Process-side service | Fixed specifications |
|---|---|---|
| Pump1 | n-butane | Isentropic pump efficiency = 0.7000; outlet pressure = 23.0000000 bar |
| Vaporiser | Water hot side; n-butane cold side | Area = 5.0000 m2; n-butane outlet temperature = 150.0000000 degC; water-side and n-butane-side pressure drops = 0 kPa |
| Preheater | Water hot side; n-butane cold side | Area = 5.0000 m2; n-butane outlet temperature = 80.0000000 degC; pressure drops = 0 kPa on both sides |
| Recuperator | n-butane hot and cold sides | Area = 1.0000 m2; n-butane cold-side outlet temperature = 60.0000000 degC; pressure drops = 0 kPa on both sides |
| Condenser | n-butane hot side; water cold side | Area = 5.0000 m2; n-butane hot-side outlet vapour fraction = 0; pressure drops = 0 kPa on both sides |
| Turbine1 | n-butane | Isentropic calculation; isentropic efficiency = 0.5000; motor efficiency = 1.0000; outlet pressure = 100.0000000 bar |
| Mixer | water | Two inlets, no heat or shaft work specified; combined outlet flow is governed by the 60 t/h downstream specification |

The saved overall heat-transfer coefficients are 61.11845911 W/(m2.K) for the
vaporiser, 15.60345335 W/(m2.K) for the preheater, 53.09910952 W/(m2.K) for the
recuperator, and 161.3163204 W/(m2.K) for the condenser. They are saved
initialization/solved values rather than independent design inputs; the outlet
targets above are paired with the exchanger heat-transfer equations.

## Process Equations and Closure

For each exchanger, the energy balance is

\[
Q_{\mathrm{cold}} = -Q_{\mathrm{hot}}
\]

and the heat-transfer relation is represented by

\[
Q = U A \Delta T_{\mathrm{lm}}, \qquad
\Delta T_{\mathrm{lm}} =
\frac{\Delta T_1-\Delta T_2}{\ln(\Delta T_1/\Delta T_2)}.
\]

Each exchanger additionally conserves component flow on each side and uses the
specified zero pressure drop. The water mixer obeys total mass and enthalpy
balances,

\[
\dot m_{out}=\dot m_1+\dot m_2, \qquad
\dot m_{out}h_{out}=\dot m_1h_1+\dot m_2h_2,
\]

with its outlet at the lower inlet pressure in the saved solution (150 kPa).

The pump and turbine use material and energy balances, their specified pressure
changes, and the stated efficiencies. The isentropic turbine relationship may
be expressed as

\[
\eta_{is}=\frac{h_{in}-h_{out}}{h_{in}-h_{out,s}},
\]

using the model's sign and pressure conventions. The saved pressure rise across
the unit called Turbine1 makes the resulting enthalpy and work directions
unconventional; the equation should therefore be implemented according to the
chosen simulator's turbine convention and checked against the results below.

In process terms, the case is closed by the n-butane circulation rate and
condenser liquid condition, the two organic pressure levels, three organic
heater outlet-temperature targets, the condenser vapour-fraction target, the
three external water-feed conditions, and the 60 t/h mixed-water flow. Heat
duties, the auxiliary-water rate, exchanger coefficients, unprescribed outlet
states, and shaft powers are calculated. No optimization, rating calculation,
or dynamic accumulation is included.

## Saved Results and Reproduction Checks

The following values are saved solved/initialization results. They are useful
for reproducing this exact case, but values identified above as calculated are
not additional design specifications.

### Heat duties and temperature approaches

Positive duty denotes heat received by the cold side.

| Exchanger | Heat duty to cold side (kW) | Temperature difference at one end (degC) | Temperature difference at other end (degC) |
|---|---:|---:|---:|
| Vaporiser | 24.39085075 | 50.00000000 | 119.6088786 |
| Preheater | 3.163201216 | 31.36334627 | 51.36334285 |
| Recuperator | 8.982202672 | 158.7379939 | 180.0268024 |
| Condenser | 28.13397564 | 175.4808630 | 0.8203302612 |

The geothermal-water exchangers supply 27.55405196 kW in total. The recuperator
recovers 8.982202672 kW internally. The cooling-water utility receives
28.13397564 kW.

### Organic-stream checks

Enthalpies below are the saved property-package values in J/mol; their zero is
the property package reference state.

| Organic location | Flow (mol/s) | Pressure (bar) | Temperature if specified (degC) | Enthalpy (J/mol) |
|---|---:|---:|---:|---:|
| Condenser outlet / Pump1 inlet | 1.0000 | 100 | 1.820330261 | -24341.82120 |
| Pump1 outlet / recuperator cold inlet | 1.0000 | 23 | not specified | -25396.44445 |
| Recuperator cold outlet / preheater inlet | 1.0000 | 23 | 60.00000000 | -16414.24178 |
| Preheater cold outlet / vaporiser inlet | 1.0000 | 23 | 80.00000000 | -13251.04057 |
| Vaporiser cold outlet / Turbine1 inlet | 1.0000 | 23 | 150.0000000 | 11139.81018 |
| Turbine1 outlet / recuperator hot inlet | 1.0000 | 100 | not specified | 12774.35711 |
| Recuperator hot outlet / condenser inlet | 1.0000 | 100 | not specified | 3792.154442 |

The saved Pump1 mechanical work is -1.054623259 kW and the saved Turbine1
mechanical and electrical work is +1.634546934 kW. Their algebraic sum is
**+0.579923675 kW**. These are reported with the model's work signs, not
relabelled as conventional power consumption or generation.

### Water-stream checks

| Water location | Flow (mol/s) | Pressure | Temperature if specified (degC) | Enthalpy (J/mol) |
|---|---:|---:|---:|---:|
| Vaporiser water inlet | 770.9510005 | 23 bar | 200.0000000 | 15358.06828 |
| Vaporiser water outlet / first mixer inlet | 770.9510005 | 23 bar | 199.6088786 | 15326.43092 |
| Auxiliary mixer inlet | 154.1902001 | 150 kPa | 95.00000000 | 7172.033816 |
| Mixer outlet / preheater water inlet | 925.1412006 | 150 kPa | not specified | 13967.36474 |
| Preheater water outlet | 925.1412006 | 150 kPa | not specified | 13963.94558 |
| Condenser cooling-water inlet | 800.0000000 | 100 kPa | 1.000000000 | 77.05317402 |
| Condenser cooling-water outlet | 800.0000000 | 100 kPa | not specified | 112.2206436 |

## Limits of Interpretation

The model encodes pure-water heat-source and utility streams, so it cannot
predict brine salinity effects, flashing caused by dissolved solids, corrosion,
scaling, or actual geothermal-well hydraulics. The saved 23-bar-to-150-kPa
water pressure change occurs at mixing without represented equipment. Most
importantly, the pump/turbine pressure and work directions are internally
unconventional. The tabulated values reproduce the encoded case, but a physical
plant design would need the pressure-changing equipment and its energy signs
reviewed before using the results for equipment sizing or power production.

141:             if _is_fixed(canonical_variable)
142:         ]
143: 
144:     def fix(self, variable: Var | IndexedVar, value=None):
145:         """Fix the active variable that supplies a registered Specification.
146: 
147:         When provided, value is assigned before the active variable is fixed.
148:         """
149:         replacement = self._replacement_for(variable)
150:         if self._is_canonical(variable) and replacement is None:
151:             if value is not None:
152:                 for item in _var_data_objects(variable):
153:                     item.set_value(value)
154:             _fix(variable)
155:             return
156: 
157:         if any(
158:             replacement.replacement_variable is variable
159:             for replacement in self._replacements
160:         ):
161:             if value is not None:
162:                 for item in _var_data_objects(variable):
163:                     item.set_value(value)
164:             _fix(variable)
165:             return
166: 
167:         raise ValueError(
168:             f"Variable {variable} is not an active Specification and cannot be fixed."
169:         )
170: 
171:     def anchor_loop_variable(self, variable: Var | IndexedVar):
172:         """Anchor a recycle variable by replacing its expanded arc equality.
173: 
174:         The caller supplies a valued port variable after arcs have been expanded.
175:         This method deactivates its sole arc-member equality, then registers and
176:         fixes the variable as a recycle-category Canonical Variable.
177:         """
178:         port_members = [
179:             (port, member_name)
180:             for port in self._flowsheet.component_objects(Port, active=True, descend_into=True)
181:             for member_name, member in port.vars.items()
182:             if member is variable
183:         ]
184:         if len(port_members) != 1:
185:             raise ValueError(
186:                 f"Loop anchor {variable} must belong to exactly one active port member."
187:             )
188: 
189:         port, member_name = port_members[0]
190:         arcs = list(port.arcs())
191:         if len(arcs) != 1:
192:             raise ValueError(
193:                 f"Loop anchor port {port.name} must be connected to exactly one arc."
194:             )
195: 
196:         arc = arcs[0]
197:         expanded_block = arc.expanded_block
198:         equality = getattr(expanded_block, f"{member_name}_equality", None)
199:         if equality is None:
200:             raise ValueError(
201:                 f"Expanded arc {arc.name} has no equality for port member {member_name}."
202:             )
203:         equality.deactivate()
204:         self.register([(variable, "recycle")])
205: 
206:     def category_of(self, canonical_variable: Var | IndexedVar):
207:         category = self._registered_category(canonical_variable)
208:         if category is None:
209:             raise ValueError(f"Variable {canonical_variable} is not a Canonical Variable.")
210:         return category
211: 
212:     def replacement_candidates_in(self, block: Block):
213:         return (
214:             variable
215:             for variable in block.component_objects(Var, descend_into=True)
216:             if not self._is_canonical(variable) and not _is_fixed(variable)
217:         )
218: 
219:     def replace(self, canonical_variable: Var | IndexedVar, replacement_variable: Var | IndexedVar):
220:         """Immediately activate a Replacement in the flowsheet solve state."""
221:         if not self._belongs_to_flowsheet(canonical_variable) or not self._belongs_to_flowsheet(
222:             replacement_variable
223:         ):
224:             raise ValueError(
225:                 f"Variables {canonical_variable} and {replacement_variable} do not belong to {self._flowsheet.name}."
226:             )
227: 
228:         existing = self._replacement_for(canonical_variable)
229:         if existing is not None:
230:             if existing.replacement_variable is not replacement_variable:
231:                 raise ValueError(
232:                     f"Canonical Variable {canonical_variable} already has an active Replacement."
233:                 )
234:             _unfix(canonical_variable)
235:             _fix(replacement_variable)
236:             return existing
237: 
238:         category = self._registered_category(canonical_variable)
239:         if category is None:
240:             raise ValueError(f"Variable {canonical_variable} is not a Canonical Variable.")
241:         if not _is_fixed(canonical_variable):
242:             raise ValueError(f"Canonical Variable {canonical_variable} must be fixed to be replaced.")
243:         if self._is_canonical(replacement_variable):
244:             raise ValueError(
245:                 f"Variable {replacement_variable} is a Canonical Variable and cannot be a Replacement."
246:             )
247:         if _is_fixed(replacement_variable):
248:             raise ValueError(
249:                 f"Variable {replacement_variable} must be unfixed to become a Replacement."
250:             )
251: 
252:         _unfix(canonical_variable)
253:         _fix(replacement_variable)
254:         igraph = IncidenceGraphInterface(self._flowsheet)
255:         _variables, constraints = igraph.dulmage_mendelsohn()
256:         if constraints.unmatched:
257:             _fix(canonical_variable)
258:             _unfix(replacement_variable)
259:             raise ValueError(
260:                 f"Replacing {canonical_variable} with {replacement_variable} causes a structural singularity in {self._flowsheet.name}. "
261:                 f"Unmatched constraints: {[constraint.name for constraint in constraints.unmatched]}"
262:             )
263: 
264:         replacement = Replacement(canonical_variable, replacement_variable, category)
265:         self._replacements.append(replacement)
266:         return replacement
267: 
268:     def undo(self, canonical_variable: Var | IndexedVar):
269:         replacement = self._replacement_for(canonical_variable)
270:         if replacement is None:
271:             raise ValueError(f"Canonical Variable {canonical_variable} has no active Replacement.")
272:         self._replacements.remove(replacement)
273:         _fix(replacement.canonical_variable)
274:         _unfix(replacement.replacement_variable)
275:         return replacement
276: 
277:     def deactivate_category(self, category: str):
278:         deactivated = [
279:             replacement for replacement in self._replacements if replacement.category == category
280:         ]
281:         for replacement in deactivated:
282:             self.undo(replacement.canonical_variable)
283:         return deactivated
284: 
285:     def replacements_in(self, block: Block):
286:         return [
287:             replacement
288:             for replacement in self._replacements
289:             if _is_child_of(block, replacement.canonical_variable)
290:         ]
291: 
292:     def internal_replacements_in(self, block: Block):
293:         return [
294:             replacement
295:             for replacement in self.replacements_in(block)
296:             if _is_child_of(block, replacement.replacement_variable)
297:         ]
298: 
299:     def external_replacements_in(self, block: Block):
300:         return [
301:             replacement
302:             for replacement in self.replacements_in(block)
303:             if not _is_child_of(block, replacement.replacement_variable)
304:         ]
305: 
306:     def external_replacements_provided_by(self, block: Block):
307:         return [
308:             replacement
309:             for replacement in self._replacements
310:             if not _is_child_of(block, replacement.canonical_variable)
311:             and _is_child_of(block, replacement.replacement_variable)
312:         ]
313: 
314:     def guesses_in(self, block: Block):
315:         return [
316:             replacement.canonical_variable
317:             for replacement in self.replacements_in(block)
318:             if not _is_fixed(replacement.canonical_variable)
319:         ]
320: 
321:     def report(self, block):
322:         print("Specification report:")
323:         print("Canonical variable -> Replacement variable (fixed/unfixed)")
324:         for canonical in self.canonical_variables_in(block):
325:             replacement = next(
326:                 (item for item in self.replacements_in(block) if item.canonical_variable is canonical),
327:                 None,
328:             )
329:             active = replacement.replacement_variable if replacement else canonical
330:             if not replacement:
331:                 print(
332:                     f"{self.category_of(canonical)}: {canonical.name} "
333:                     f"({'fixed' if all(item.fixed for item in active.values()) else 'unfixed'})"
334:                 )
335:             else:
336:                 print(
337:                     f"{self.category_of(canonical)}: {canonical.name} "
338:                     f"-> {active.name} ({'fixed' if all(item.fixed for item in active.values()) else 'unfixed'})"
339:                 )
340: 
341:     @contextmanager
342:     def replacements_suspended_in(self, block: Block):
343:         with self._replacements_suspended(self.replacements_in(block)):
344:             yield self
345: 
346:     @contextmanager
347:     def external_replacements_suspended_in(self, block: Block):
348:         replacements = self.external_replacements_in(
349:             block
350:         ) + self.external_replacements_provided_by(block)
351:         with self._replacements_suspended(replacements):
352:             yield self
353: 
354:     @contextmanager
355:     def _replacements_suspended(self, replacements: list[Replacement]):
356:         snapshots = {
357:             replacement: _snapshot(replacement.replacement_variable)
358:             for replacement in replacements
359:         }
360:         try:
361:             for replacement in replacements:
362:                 _fix(replacement.canonical_variable)
363:                 _unfix(replacement.replacement_variable)
364:             yield
365:         finally:
366:             for replacement in replacements:
367:                 _unfix(replacement.canonical_variable)
368:                 _restore(snapshots[replacement])
369: 
370:     def _registered_category(self, variable: Var | IndexedVar):
371:         for canonical_variable, category in self._canonical_variables:
372:             if canonical_variable is variable:
373:                 return category
374:         return None
375: 
376:     def _is_canonical(self, variable: Var | IndexedVar):
377:         return self._registered_category(variable) is not None

382:                 return replacement

# Pyomo Replacement

Pyomo Replacement manages which model variables specify a flowsheet and how those specifications can be replaced while preserving a solvable model.

## Language

**Specification**:
A flowsheet-level declaration that a canonical variable, or its active replacement, supplies one degree of freedom for a model.
_Avoid_: state variable, configuration

**Canonical Variable**:
A variable registered as the ordinary specification for the block that owns it. It becomes a guess variable while an active replacement supplies that specification.
_Avoid_: state variable

**Specification Category**:
A label that groups Canonical Variables by their role, such as inlet, operation, design, initial condition, or recycle.
_Avoid_: variable type

**Replacement**:
The active substitution of a canonical variable with a non-canonical variable as the specification for the same degree of freedom.
_Avoid_: alias, link

**Internal Replacement**:
A Replacement whose canonical variable and replacement variable are both contained by the same queried block.
_Avoid_: local replacement, initialisation replacement

**External Replacement**:
A Replacement with one variable contained by a queried block and the other outside it.
_Avoid_: cross-block replacement

**Provided External Replacement**:
An External Replacement whose replacement variable is contained by the queried block and whose Canonical Variable is outside it. The queried block provides a Specification to another block.
_Avoid_: incoming replacement, outgoing replacement

**Loop Anchor**:
A flowsheet-level Canonical Variable in the recycle category that supplies a recycle-loop degree of freedom by replacing exactly one expanded arc member equality for its connected port member.
_Avoid_: tear guess, recycle fix

**Replacement Candidate**:
An unfixed non-canonical variable that can potentially become a Replacement.
_Avoid_: available variable

**Guess Variable**:
A canonical variable made unfixed by an active replacement.
_Avoid_: replacement variable

def _is_child_of(block, component):
    parent = component.parent_block()
    while parent is not None:
        if parent is block:
            return True
        parent = parent.parent_block()
    return False

473:     def build(self):
474:         """
475: 
476:         Args:
477:             None
478: 
479:         Returns:
480:             None
481:         """
482:         # Call UnitModel.build
483:         super().build()
484: 
485:         # Add a control volume to the unit including setting up dynamics.
486:         self.control_volume = ControlVolume0DBlock(
487:             dynamic=self.config.dynamic,
488:             has_holdup=self.config.has_holdup,
489:             property_package=self.config.property_package,
490:             property_package_args=self.config.property_package_args,
491:         )
492: 
493:         # Add geometry variables to control volume
494:         if self.config.has_holdup:
495:             self.control_volume.add_geometry()
496: 
497:         # Add inlet and outlet state blocks to control volume
498:         self.control_volume.add_state_blocks(
499:             has_phase_equilibrium=self.config.has_phase_equilibrium
500:         )
501: 
502:         # Add mass balance
503:         # Set has_equilibrium is False for now
504:         # TO DO; set has_equilibrium to True
505:         self.control_volume.add_material_balances(
506:             balance_type=self.config.material_balance_type,
507:             has_phase_equilibrium=self.config.has_phase_equilibrium,
508:         )
509: 
510:         # Add energy balance
511:         eb = self.control_volume.add_energy_balances(
512:             balance_type=self.config.energy_balance_type, has_work_transfer=True
513:         )
514: 
515:         # add momentum balance
516:         self.control_volume.add_momentum_balances(
517:             balance_type=self.config.momentum_balance_type, has_pressure_change=True
518:         )
519: 
520:         # Add Ports
521:         self.add_inlet_port()
522:         self.add_outlet_port()
523: 
524:         # Set Unit Geometry and holdup Volume
525:         if self.config.has_holdup is True:
526:             self.volume = Reference(self.control_volume.volume[:])
527: 
528:         # Construct performance equations
529:         # Set references to balance terms at unit level
530:         # Add Work transfer variable 'work'
531:         # If the 'work' variable wasn't already built on the control volume but is needed, create it now.
532:         if (
533:             not hasattr(self.control_volume, "work")
534:             and self.config.thermodynamic_assumption == ThermodynamicAssumption.pump
535:             and eb is None
536:         ):
537:             units = (
538:                 self.control_volume.config.property_package.get_metadata().get_derived_units
539:             )
540:             self.control_volume.work = Var(
541:                 self.flowsheet().time,
542:                 domain=Reals,
543:                 initialize=0.0,
544:                 doc="Work transferred into control volume",
545:                 units=units("power"),
546:             )
547:         self.work_mechanical = Reference(self.control_volume.work[:])
548: 
549:         # Add Momentum balance variable 'deltaP'
550:         self.deltaP = Reference(self.control_volume.deltaP[:])
551: 
552:         # Performance Variables
553:         self.ratioP = Var(self.flowsheet().time, initialize=1.0, doc="Pressure Ratio")
554: 
555:         # Pressure Ratio
556:         @self.Constraint(self.flowsheet().time, doc="Pressure ratio constraint")
557:         def ratioP_calculation(self, t):
558:             return (
559:                 self.ratioP[t] * self.control_volume.properties_in[t].pressure
560:                 == self.control_volume.properties_out[t].pressure
561:             )
562: 
563:         # Construct equations for thermodynamic assumption
564:         if self.config.thermodynamic_assumption == ThermodynamicAssumption.isothermal:
565:             self.add_isothermal()
566:         elif self.config.thermodynamic_assumption == ThermodynamicAssumption.isentropic:
567:             self.add_isentropic()
568:         elif self.config.thermodynamic_assumption == ThermodynamicAssumption.pump:
569:             self.add_pump()
570:         elif self.config.thermodynamic_assumption == ThermodynamicAssumption.adiabatic:
571:             self.add_adiabatic()

573:     def add_pump(self):
574:         """
575:         Add constraints for the incompressible fluid assumption
576: 
577:         Args:
578:             None
579: 
580:         Returns:
581:             None
582:         """
583:         units_meta = self.control_volume.config.property_package.get_metadata()
584: 
585:         self.work_fluid = Var(
586:             self.flowsheet().time,
587:             initialize=1.0,
588:             doc="Work required to increase the pressure of the liquid",
589:             units=units_meta.get_derived_units("power"),
590:         )
591:         self.efficiency_pump = Var(
592:             self.flowsheet().time, initialize=1.0, doc="Pump efficiency"
593:         )
594: 
595:         @self.Constraint(self.flowsheet().time, doc="Pump fluid work constraint")
596:         def fluid_work_calculation(self, t):
597:             return self.work_fluid[t] == (
598:                 (
599:                     self.control_volume.properties_out[t].pressure
600:                     - self.control_volume.properties_in[t].pressure
601:                 )
602:                 * self.control_volume.properties_out[t].flow_vol
603:             )
604: 
605:         # Actual work
606:         @self.Constraint(
607:             self.flowsheet().time, doc="Actual mechanical work calculation"
608:         )
609:         def actual_work(self, t):
610:             if self.config.compressor:
611:                 return self.work_fluid[t] == (
612:                     self.work_mechanical[t] * self.efficiency_pump[t]
613:                 )
614:             else:
615:                 return self.work_mechanical[t] == (
616:                     self.work_fluid[t] * self.efficiency_pump[t]
617:                 )
618: 
619:     def add_isothermal(self):
620:         """
621:         Add constraints for isothermal assumption.
622: 
623:         Args:
624:             None
625: 
626:         Returns:
627:             None
628:         """
629: 
630:         # Isothermal constraint
631:         @self.Constraint(
632:             self.flowsheet().time,
633:             doc="For isothermal condition: Equate inlet and " "outlet temperature",
634:         )
635:         def isothermal(self, t):
636:             return (
637:                 self.control_volume.properties_in[t].temperature
638:                 == self.control_volume.properties_out[t].temperature
639:             )
640: 
641:     def add_adiabatic(self):
642:         """
643:         Add constraints for adiabatic assumption.
644: 
645:         Args:
646:             None
647: 
648:         Returns:
649:             None
650:         """
651: 
652:         @self.Constraint(self.flowsheet().time)
653:         def zero_work_equation(self, t):
654:             return self.control_volume.work[t] == 0
655: 
656:     def add_isentropic(self):
657:         """
658:         Add constraints for isentropic assumption.
659: 
660:         Args:
661:             None
662: 
663:         Returns:
664:             None
665:         """
666:         units_meta = self.control_volume.config.property_package.get_metadata()
667: 
668:         # Get indexing sets from control volume
669:         # Add isentropic variables
670:         self.efficiency_isentropic = Var(
671:             self.flowsheet().time,
672:             initialize=0.8,
673:             doc="Efficiency with respect to an isentropic process [-]",
674:         )
675:         self.work_isentropic = Var(
676:             self.flowsheet().time,
677:             initialize=0.0,
678:             doc="Work input to unit if isentropic process",
679:             units=units_meta.get_derived_units("power"),
680:         )
681: 
682:         # Build isentropic state block
683:         tmp_dict = dict(**self.config.property_package_args)
684:         tmp_dict["has_phase_equilibrium"] = self.config.has_phase_equilibrium
685:         tmp_dict["defined_state"] = False
686: 
687:         self.properties_isentropic = self.config.property_package.build_state_block(
688:             self.flowsheet().time, doc="isentropic properties at outlet", **tmp_dict
689:         )
690: 
691:         # Connect isentropic state block properties
692:         @self.Constraint(
693:             self.flowsheet().time, doc="Pressure for isentropic calculations"
694:         )
695:         def isentropic_pressure(self, t):
696:             return (
697:                 self.properties_isentropic[t].pressure
698:                 == self.control_volume.properties_out[t].pressure
699:             )
700: 
701:         # This assumes isentropic composition is the same as outlet
702:         self.add_state_material_balances(
703:             self.config.material_balance_type,
704:             self.properties_isentropic,
705:             self.control_volume.properties_out,
706:         )
707: 
708:         # This assumes isentropic entropy is the same as inlet
709:         @self.Constraint(self.flowsheet().time, doc="Isentropic assumption")
710:         def isentropic(self, t):
711:             return (
712:                 self.properties_isentropic[t].entr_mol
713:                 == self.control_volume.properties_in[t].entr_mol
714:             )
715: 
716:         # Isentropic work
717:         @self.Constraint(
718:             self.flowsheet().time, doc="Calculate work of isentropic process"
719:         )
720:         def isentropic_energy_balance(self, t):
721:             return self.work_isentropic[t] == (
722:                 sum(
723:                     self.properties_isentropic[t].get_enthalpy_flow_terms(p)
724:                     for p in self.properties_isentropic.phase_list
725:                 )
726:                 - sum(
727:                     self.control_volume.properties_in[t].get_enthalpy_flow_terms(p)
728:                     for p in self.control_volume.properties_in.phase_list
729:                 )
730:             )
731: 
732:         # Actual work
733:         @self.Constraint(
734:             self.flowsheet().time, doc="Actual mechanical work calculation"
735:         )
736:         def actual_work(self, t):
737:             if self.config.compressor:
738:                 return self.work_isentropic[t] == (
739:                     self.work_mechanical[t] * self.efficiency_isentropic[t]
740:                 )
741:             else:
742:                 return self.work_mechanical[t] == (
743:                     self.work_isentropic[t] * self.efficiency_isentropic[t]
744:                 )
745: 
746:         if self.config.support_isentropic_performance_curves:
747:             self.performance_curve = IsentropicPerformanceCurve(
748:                 **self.config.isentropic_performance_curves
749:             )

751:     def model_check(blk):
752:         """
753:         Check that pressure change matches with compressor argument (i.e. if
754:         compressor = True, pressure should increase or work should be positive)
755: 
756:         Args:
757:             None
758: 
759:         Returns:
760:             None
761:         """
762:         if blk.config.compressor:
763:             # Compressor
764:             # Check that pressure does not decrease
765:             if any(
766:                 blk.deltaP[t].fixed and (value(blk.deltaP[t]) < 0.0)
767:                 for t in blk.flowsheet().time
768:             ):
769:                 _log.warning("{} Compressor set with negative deltaP.".format(blk.name))
770:             if any(
771:                 blk.ratioP[t].fixed and (value(blk.ratioP[t]) < 1.0)
772:                 for t in blk.flowsheet().time
773:             ):
774:                 _log.warning(
775:                     "{} Compressor set with ratioP less than 1.".format(blk.name)
776:                 )
777:             if any(
778:                 blk.control_volume.properties_out[t].pressure.fixed
779:                 and (
780:                     value(blk.control_volume.properties_in[t].pressure)
781:                     > value(blk.control_volume.properties_out[t].pressure)
782:                 )
783:                 for t in blk.flowsheet().time
784:             ):
785:                 _log.warning(
786:                     "{} Compressor set with pressure decrease.".format(blk.name)
787:                 )
788:             # Check that work is not negative
789:             if any(
790:                 blk.work_mechanical[t].fixed and (value(blk.work_mechanical[t]) < 0.0)
791:                 for t in blk.flowsheet().time
792:             ):
793:                 _log.warning(
794:                     "{} Compressor maybe set with negative work.".format(blk.name)
795:                 )
796:         else:
797:             # Expander
798:             # Check that pressure does not increase
799:             if any(
800:                 blk.deltaP[t].fixed and (value(blk.deltaP[t]) > 0.0)
801:                 for t in blk.flowsheet().time
802:             ):
803:                 _log.warning(
804:                     "{} Expander/turbine set with positive deltaP.".format(blk.name)
805:                 )
806:             if any(
807:                 blk.ratioP[t].fixed and (value(blk.ratioP[t]) > 1.0)
808:                 for t in blk.flowsheet().time
809:             ):
810:                 _log.warning(
811:                     "{} Expander/turbine set with ratioP greater "
812:                     "than 1.".format(blk.name)
813:                 )
814:             if any(
815:                 blk.control_volume.properties_out[t].pressure.fixed
816:                 and (
817:                     value(blk.control_volume.properties_in[t].pressure)
818:                     < value(blk.control_volume.properties_out[t].pressure)
819:                 )
820:                 for t in blk.flowsheet().time
821:             ):
822:                 _log.warning(
823:                     "{} Expander/turbine maybe set with pressure "
824:                     "increase.".format(blk.name),
825:                 )
826:             # Check that work is not positive
827:             if any(
828:                 blk.work_mechanical[t].fixed and (value(blk.work_mechanical[t]) > 0.0)
829:                 for t in blk.flowsheet().time
830:             ):
831:                 _log.warning(
832:                     "{} Expander/turbine set with positive work.".format(blk.name)
833:                 )
834: 
835:         # Run holdup block model checks
836:         blk.control_volume.model_check()
837: 
838:         # Run model checks on isentropic property block
839:         try:
840:             for t in blk.flowsheet().time:
841:                 blk.properties_in[t].model_check()
842:         except AttributeError:
843:             pass

845:     def initialize_build(
846:         blk,
847:         state_args=None,
848:         routine=None,
849:         outlvl=idaeslog.NOTSET,
850:         solver=None,
851:         optarg=None,
852:     ):
853:         """
854:         General wrapper for pressure changer initialization routines
855: 
856:         Keyword Arguments:
857:             routine : str stating which initialization routine to execute
858:                         * None - use routine matching thermodynamic_assumption
859:                         * 'isentropic' - use isentropic initialization routine
860:                         * 'isothermal' - use isothermal initialization routine
861:             state_args : a dict of arguments to be passed to the property
862:                          package(s) to provide an initial state for
863:                          initialization (see documentation of the specific
864:                          property package) (default = {}).
865:             outlvl : sets output level of initialization routine
866:             optarg : solver options dictionary object (default=None, use
867:                      default solver options)
868:             solver : str indicating which solver to use during
869:                      initialization (default = None, use default solver)
870: 
871:         Returns:
872:             None
873:         """
874:         if routine is None:
875:             # Use routine for specific type of unit
876:             routine = blk.config.thermodynamic_assumption
877: 
878:         # Call initialization routine
879:         if routine is ThermodynamicAssumption.isentropic:
880:             blk.init_isentropic(
881:                 state_args=state_args, outlvl=outlvl, solver=solver, optarg=optarg
882:             )
883:         elif routine is ThermodynamicAssumption.adiabatic:
884:             blk.init_adiabatic(
885:                 state_args=state_args, outlvl=outlvl, solver=solver, optarg=optarg
886:             )
887:         else:
888:             # Call the general initialization routine in UnitModelBlockData
889:             super().initialize_build(
890:                 state_args=state_args, outlvl=outlvl, solver=solver, optarg=optarg
891:             )
892: 
893:     def init_adiabatic(blk, state_args, outlvl, solver, optarg):
894:         """
895:         Initialization routine for adiabatic pressure changers.
896: 
897:         Keyword Arguments:
898:             state_args : a dict of arguments to be passed to the property
899:                          package(s) to provide an initial state for
900:                          initialization (see documentation of the specific
901:                          property package) (default = {}).
902:             outlvl : sets output level of initialization routine
903:             optarg : solver options dictionary object (default={})
904:             solver : str indicating which solver to use during
905:                      initialization (default = None)
906: 
907:         Returns:
908:             None
909:         """
910:         init_log = idaeslog.getInitLogger(blk.name, outlvl, tag="unit")
911:         solve_log = idaeslog.getSolveLogger(blk.name, outlvl, tag="unit")
912: 
913:         # Create solver
914:         opt = get_solver(solver, optarg)
915: 
916:         cv = blk.control_volume
917:         t0 = blk.flowsheet().time.first()
918: 
919:         if state_args is None:
920:             state_args = extract_state_args(cv.properties_in[t0], use_state_vars=False)
921: 
922:         # Initialize state blocks
923:         flags = cv.properties_in.initialize(
924:             outlvl=outlvl,
925:             optarg=optarg,
926:             solver=solver,
927:             hold_state=True,
928:             state_args=state_args,
929:         )
930: 
931:         # Get initialisation guesses for outlet state
932:         state_args_out = {}
933:         # refresh inlet values (may have changed during initialization)
934:         inlet_state_args = extract_state_args(cv.properties_in[t0], use_state_vars=False)
935:         for k in state_args:
936:             if k == "pressure" and k not in state_args_out:
937:                 # Work out how to estimate outlet pressure
938:                 if cv.properties_out[t0].pressure.fixed:
939:                     # Fixed outlet pressure, use this value
940:                     state_args_out[k] = value(cv.properties_out[t0].pressure)
941:                 elif blk.deltaP[t0].fixed:
942:                     state_args_out[k] = value(
943:                         cv.properties_in[t0].pressure + blk.deltaP[t0]
944:                     )
945:                 elif blk.ratioP[t0].fixed:
946:                     state_args_out[k] = value(
947:                         cv.properties_in[t0].pressure * blk.ratioP[t0]
948:                     )
949:                 else:
950:                     # Not obvious what to do, use inlet state
951:                     state_args_out[k] = value(cv.properties_in[t0].pressure)
952:             elif k not in state_args_out:
953:                 # use the inlet state as a guess for the outlet state
954:                 state_args_out[k] = inlet_state_args[k]
955: 
956:         cv.properties_out.initialize(
957:             outlvl=outlvl,
958:             optarg=optarg,
959:             solver=solver,
960:             hold_state=False,
961:             state_args=state_args_out,
962:         )
963:         init_log.info_high("Initialization Step 1 Complete.")
964: 
965:         # ---------------------------------------------------------------------
966:         # Solve unit
967:         with idaeslog.solver_log(solve_log, idaeslog.DEBUG) as slc:
968:             res = opt.solve(blk, tee=slc.tee)
969:         init_log.info_high("Initialization Step 2 {}.".format(idaeslog.condition(res)))
970: 
971:         # ---------------------------------------------------------------------
972:         # Release Inlet state
973:         blk.control_volume.release_state(flags, outlvl)
974: 
975:         if not check_optimal_termination(res):
976:             raise InitializationError(
977:                 f"{blk.name} failed to initialize successfully. Please check "
978:                 f"the output logs for more information."
979:             )
980:

"""
Standard IDAES pressure changer model.
"""
# TODO: Missing docstrings

# Changing existing config block attributes
# pylint: disable=protected-access

# Import Python libraries
from enum import Enum

# Import Pyomo libraries
from pyomo.environ import (
    Block,
    value,
    Var,
    Expression,
    Constraint,
    Reference,
    check_optimal_termination,
    Reals,
)
from pyomo.common.config import ConfigBlock, ConfigValue, In, Bool

# Import IDAES cores
from idaes.core import (
    ControlVolume0DBlock,
    declare_process_block_class,
    EnergyBalanceType,
    MomentumBalanceType,
    MaterialBalanceType,
    ProcessBlockData,
